authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly gives Bashkarik účuṭ, feminine ičiṭ, very small under ucchōṭṭa; the separately installed Gawri dictionary attests úcuṭ few/some. The survey forms preserve the diagnostic initial u plus palatal segment and final retroflex stop. The local sibilant/affricate and aspiration variants are treated as a qualified lexical family, not as separate roots.
